SELECT 'charge' AS kind,json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) AS data FROM charges WHERE booking_id='bkg_6f35afa63f225c038ee867f76e6aeebf' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_anomaly',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'amount',b.amount_cents,'captured',count(c.charge_id),'charged',sum(c.amount_cents)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' WHERE b.status='confirmed' GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING count(c.charge_id)<>1 OR sum(c.amount_cents)<>b.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'event_quarantined',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'booking_status',b.status) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='quarantined' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_confirmed',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_hold',json_object('booking_id',h.booking_id) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id OR b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
